title: The Drifting Island
text: An island of earth and grass floats past in the dark, trailing roots like a jellyfish. A single tree grows on it, heavy with pale fruit. It is close enough to jump to, for now, and drifting slowly away into nothing.

options.label: Jump to it before it drifts away.

outcomes.text: It carries you a long way through the dark, and sets you down gently.
It carries you somewhere you did not mean to go, and leaves.

options.label: The quickest leaps over, grabs the fruit, and leaps back.

outcomes.text: Fruit that glows, and tastes of a home none of you have seen.
As it drifts away, something on it stands up and waves.
